mapper.insert: /* PT 프로젝트 등록 proposal.insertProject */ INSERT INTO tb_pt_project ( PT_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NM, ORG_NM, PROJECT_OVERVIEW, TARGET_TYPE_CD, DUE_DT, STATUS_CD, WRITING_GUIDELINE_JSON, PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON, CREATE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{ptProjectId}, #{projectNm}, #{orgNm}, #{projectOverview}, #{targetTypeCd}, #{dueDt}, #{statusCd}, #{writingGuidelineJson}, #{projectConfigJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createUserId} )
mapper.select: /* PT 프로젝트 단건 조회 proposal.selectProject */ SELECT PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , PROJECT_NM AS PROJECT_NM , ORG_NM AS ORG_NM , PROJECT_OVERVIEW AS PROJECT_OVERVIEW , TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD , DATE_FORMAT(DUE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DUE_DT , STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD , CAST(WRITING_GUIDELINE_JSON AS CHAR) AS WRITING_GUIDELINE_JSON , CAST(PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON AS CHAR) AS PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON , MAX_STEP_NO AS MAX_STEP_NO , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT , MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_PROJECT WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId}

/* PT 파일 단건 조회 proposal.selectPtFileById */ SELECT PT_FILE_ID AS PT_FILE_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , FILE_PURPOSE_CD AS FILE_PURPOSE_CD , FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH , FILE_NM AS FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE AS FILE_TYPE , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_FILE WHERE PT_FILE_ID = #{ptFileId}

/* PT 프로젝트의 용도별 파일 조회 (RFP_FILE_ID/EVAL_TABLE_FILE_ID 컬럼 제거 후 대체 쿼리) FILE_PURPOSE_CD (PT000011): 001=RFP원문, 002=평가표, 003=템플릿, 004=기타참고자료, 005=자사정보, 006=경쟁사정보 proposal.selectPtFileByPurpose */ SELECT PT_FILE_ID AS PT_FILE_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , FILE_PURPOSE_CD AS FILE_PURPOSE_CD , FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH , FILE_NM AS FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE AS FILE_TYPE , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_FILE WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND FILE_PURPOSE_CD = #{filePurposeCd} ORDER BY CREATE_DT DESC

/* PT 요구사항 목록 조회 proposal.selectRequirements */ SELECT REQUIREMENT_ID AS REQUIREMENT_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , REQ_NO AS REQ_NO , REQ_CATEGORY_CD AS REQ_CATEGORY_CD , REQ_CONTENT AS REQ_CONTENT , MANDATORY_YN AS MANDATORY_YN , SOURCE_TYPE_CD AS SOURCE_TYPE_CD , CONFIRM_NEEDED_YN AS CONFIRM_NEEDED_YN , SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_REQUIREMENT WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, REQUIREMENT_ID

/* PT 평가기준 목록 조회 proposal.selectEvalCriteria */ SELECT EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS EVAL_CRITERIA_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , EVAL_ITEM_NM AS EVAL_ITEM_NM , SCORE AS SCORE , EVAL_INTENT AS EVAL_INTENT , HIGH_SCORE_CONDITION AS HIGH_SCORE_CONDITION , REQUIRED_EVIDENCE AS REQUIRED_EVIDENCE , DIFFERENTIATION_DIRECTION AS DIFFERENTIATION_DIRECTION , SLIDE_REFLECT_POSITION AS SLIDE_REFLECT_POSITION , SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_EVAL_CRITERIA WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, EVAL_CRITERIA_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION ( PROBLEM_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, PROBLEM_TYPE_CD, CURRENT_PROBLEM, ROOT_CAUSE, RISK_IF_IGNORED, GOAL, REQUIRED_CAPABILITY, STRATEGY_SUMMARY, KPI, SOURCE_TYPE_CD, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{problemId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{problemTypeCd}, #{currentProblem}, #{rootCause}, #{riskIfIgnored}, #{goal}, #{requiredCapability}, #{strategySummary}, #{kpi}, COALESCE(#{sourceTypeCd}, '002'), COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT PROBLEM_ID AS PROBLEM_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, PROBLEM_TYPE_CD AS PROBLEM_TYPE_CD, CURRENT_PROBLEM AS CURRENT_PROBLEM, ROOT_CAUSE AS ROOT_CAUSE, RISK_IF_IGNORED AS RISK_IF_IGNORED, GOAL AS GOAL, REQUIRED_CAPABILITY AS REQUIRED_CAPABILITY, STRATEGY_SUMMARY AS STRATEGY_SUMMARY, KPI AS KPI, SOURCE_TYPE_CD AS SOURCE_TYPE_CD, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, PROBLEM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_WIN_THEME ( WIN_THEME_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, CORE_MESSAGE, CUSTOMER_PROBLEM, PROPOSAL_STRATEGY, EVIDENCE, EXPECTED_EFFECT, DIFFERENTIATION, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{winThemeId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{coreMessage}, #{customerProblem}, #{proposalStrategy}, #{evidence}, #{expectedEffect}, #{differentiation}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT WIN_THEME_ID AS WIN_THEME_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, CORE_MESSAGE AS CORE_MESSAGE, CUSTOMER_PROBLEM AS CUSTOMER_PROBLEM, PROPOSAL_STRATEGY AS PROPOSAL_STRATEGY, EVIDENCE AS EVIDENCE, EXPECTED_EFFECT AS EXPECTED_EFFECT, DIFFERENTIATION AS DIFFERENTIATION, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_WIN_THEME WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, WIN_THEME_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PT_TOC ( TOC_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, PARENT_TOC_ID, SECTION_NO, SECTION_NM, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, SORT_ORD, GUIDE_CONTENT, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{tocId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{parentTocId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sectionNo}, #{sectionNm}, #{linkedEvalCriteriaId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{plannedSlideCnt}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{guideContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT t.TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, t.PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, t.PARENT_TOC_ID AS PARENT_TOC_ID, t.SECTION_NO AS SECTION_NO, t.SECTION_NM AS SECTION_NM, t.LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, t.PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, t.SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, t.GUIDE_CONTENT AS GUIDE_CONTENT, t.CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(t.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_TOC t LEFT JOIN TB_PT_TOC p ON t.PARENT_TOC_ID = p.TOC_ID WHERE t.PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY COALESCE(p.SORT_ORD, t.SORT_ORD), /* 대목차 그룹핑 기준 (소목차는 부모 SORT_ORD로 묶음) */ (t.PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL), /* 대목차(0) 먼저, 소목차(1) 나중 */ t.SORT_ORD, t.TOC_ID
/* Stage2 실행 여부 확인 proposal.countProblemDefinitions */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PT_PROBLEM_DEFINITION WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId}

/* TOC 단건 조회 proposal.selectTocById */ SELECT TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, PARENT_TOC_ID AS PARENT_TOC_ID, SECTION_NO AS SECTION_NO, SECTION_NM AS SECTION_NM, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, COVERED_REQ_IDS_JSON AS COVERED_REQ_IDS_JSON, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, GUIDE_CONTENT AS GUIDE_CONTENT, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId}

/* 소목차(leaf) 목록 조회 proposal.selectLeafTocList */ SELECT TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, PARENT_TOC_ID AS PARENT_TOC_ID, SECTION_NO AS SECTION_NO, SECTION_NM AS SECTION_NM, LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS LINKED_EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT AS PLANNED_SLIDE_CNT, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, GUIDE_CONTENT AS GUIDE_CONTENT FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SORT_ORD, TOC_ID

/* 다음 소목차 조회 proposal.selectNextLeafToc */ SELECT TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, PARENT_TOC_ID AS PARENT_TOC_ID, SECTION_NM AS SECTION_NM, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND PARENT_TOC_ID IS NOT NULL AND SORT_ORD > ( SELECT COALESCE(SORT_ORD, 0) FROM TB_PT_TOC WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId} ) ORDER BY SORT_ORD LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: /* 슬라이드 등록 proposal.insertSlide */ INSERT INTO TB_PT_SLIDE ( SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO, LAYOUT_TYPE_CD, REQ_IDS_JSON, EYEBROW_TXT, TITLE_TXT, SUBTITLE_TXT, HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT, COMPONENTS_JSON, STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON, CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT, COLOR_INDEX, IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDER_STATUS_CD, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{slideId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{tocId}, #{slideNo}, #{layoutType}, #{reqIdsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{eyebrowTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{titleTxt}, #{subtitleTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{highlightBannerTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{componentsJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stepFlowBarJson, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{conclusionRibbonTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{colorIndex}, #{imageGenHint, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{renderStatusCd}, '001'), #{renderedImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 0), #{createUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: /* 소목차 슬라이드 목록 조회 proposal.selectSlidesByToc */ SELECT SLIDE_ID AS SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO AS SLIDE_NO, LAYOUT_TYPE_CD AS LAYOUT_TYPE, CAST(REQ_IDS_JSON AS CHAR) AS REQ_IDS_JSON, EYEBROW_TXT AS EYEBROW_TXT, TITLE_TXT AS TITLE_TXT, SUBTITLE_TXT AS SUBTITLE_TXT, HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT AS HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT, CAST(COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS COMPONENTS_JSON, CAST(STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON AS CHAR) AS STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON, CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT AS CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT, COLOR_INDEX AS COLOR_INDEX, IMAGE_GEN_HINT AS IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH AS RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, COMPOSITE_IMAGE_PATH AS COMPOSITE_IMAGE_PATH, RENDER_STATUS_CD AS RENDER_STATUS_CD, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId} ORDER BY SLIDE_NO

/* 슬라이드 단건 조회 proposal.selectSlideById */ SELECT SLIDE_ID AS SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO AS SLIDE_NO, LAYOUT_TYPE_CD AS LAYOUT_TYPE, CAST(REQ_IDS_JSON AS CHAR) AS REQ_IDS_JSON, EYEBROW_TXT AS EYEBROW_TXT, TITLE_TXT AS TITLE_TXT, SUBTITLE_TXT AS SUBTITLE_TXT, HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT AS HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT, CAST(COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS COMPONENTS_JSON, CAST(STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON AS CHAR) AS STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON, CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT AS CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT, COLOR_INDEX AS COLOR_INDEX, IMAGE_GEN_HINT AS IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH AS RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, RENDER_STATUS_CD AS RENDER_STATUS_CD, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE SLIDE_ID = #{slideId}
mapper.delete: /* 소목차 슬라이드 전체 삭제 proposal.deleteSlidesByToc */ DELETE FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE TOC_ID = #{tocId}
mapper.select: /* 프로젝트 전체 슬라이드 목록 조회 (SLIDE_NO 순) proposal.selectAllSlidesByProject */ SELECT SLIDE_ID AS SLIDE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, TOC_ID AS TOC_ID, SLIDE_NO AS SLIDE_NO, LAYOUT_TYPE_CD AS LAYOUT_TYPE, CAST(REQ_IDS_JSON AS CHAR) AS REQ_IDS_JSON, EYEBROW_TXT AS EYEBROW_TXT, TITLE_TXT AS TITLE_TXT, SUBTITLE_TXT AS SUBTITLE_TXT, HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT AS HIGHLIGHT_BANNER_TXT, CAST(COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS COMPONENTS_JSON, CAST(STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON AS CHAR) AS STEP_FLOW_BAR_JSON, CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT AS CONCLUSION_RIBBON_TXT, COLOR_INDEX AS COLOR_INDEX, IMAGE_GEN_HINT AS IMAGE_GEN_HINT, RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH AS RENDERED_IMAGE_PATH, RENDER_STATUS_CD AS RENDER_STATUS_CD, SORT_ORD AS SORT_ORD, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT, DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_SLIDE WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} ORDER BY SLIDE_NO
mapper.insert: /* Stage4 평가 시뮬레이션 결과 등록 proposal.insertReview */ INSERT INTO TB_PT_REVIEW ( REVIEW_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, SLIDE_ID, EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, SEVERITY_CD, EVAL_CRITERIA_NM, CURRENT_ISSUE, SCORE_IMPACT, FIX_DIRECTION, FIX_SUGGESTION_TXT, EXPECTED_SCORE, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DT ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{slideId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{evalCriteriaId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{severityCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{evalCriteriaNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currentIssue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{scoreImpact, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fixDirection, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fixSuggestionTxt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expectedScore, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{createUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW() )
mapper.select: /* 특정 실행 시각의 Stage4 결과 조회 (심각도순) proposal.selectReviewsByRunDt */ SELECT REVIEW_ID AS REVIEW_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, SLIDE_ID AS SLIDE_ID, EVAL_CRITERIA_ID AS EVAL_CRITERIA_ID, SEVERITY_CD AS SEVERITY_CD, EVAL_CRITERIA_NM AS EVAL_CRITERIA_NM, CURRENT_ISSUE AS CURRENT_ISSUE, SCORE_IMPACT AS SCORE_IMPACT, FIX_DIRECTION AS FIX_DIRECTION, FIX_SUGGESTION_TXT AS FIX_SUGGESTION_TXT, EXPECTED_SCORE AS EXPECTED_SCORE, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_REVIEW WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') = #{runDt} ORDER BY CASE SEVERITY_CD WHEN '001' THEN 1 WHEN '002' THEN 2 WHEN '003' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, CREATE_DT

/* PT 출력 단건 조회 proposal.selectExportById */ SELECT EXPORT_ID AS EXPORT_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, EXPORT_TYPE_CD AS EXPORT_TYPE_CD, BUILD_STATUS_CD AS BUILD_STATUS_CD, TOTAL_SLIDE_CNT AS TOTAL_SLIDE_CNT, RENDERED_SLIDE_CNT AS RENDERED_SLIDE_CNT, FILE_NM AS FILE_NM, FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE, ERROR_MSG AS ERROR_MSG, DATE_FORMAT(COMPLETE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS COMPLETE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_EXPORT WHERE EXPORT_ID = #{exportId}

/* 프로젝트+내보내기형식 기준 최근 완료 출력 빌드 조회 (캐시 재사용 판단용) proposal.selectLatestCompletedExport */ SELECT EXPORT_ID AS EXPORT_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID, EXPORT_TYPE_CD AS EXPORT_TYPE_CD, BUILD_STATUS_CD AS BUILD_STATUS_CD, TOTAL_SLIDE_CNT AS TOTAL_SLIDE_CNT, RENDERED_SLIDE_CNT AS RENDERED_SLIDE_CNT, FILE_NM AS FILE_NM, FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE, ERROR_MSG AS ERROR_MSG, DATE_FORMAT(COMPLETE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS COMPLETE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_PT_EXPORT WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId} AND EXPORT_TYPE_CD = #{exportTypeCd} AND BUILD_STATUS_CD = '004' ORDER BY COMPLETE_DT DESC LIMIT 1

/* PT 템플릿 단건 조회 (PT_PROJECT_ID 기준) proposal.selectPtTemplate */ SELECT TEMPLATE_ID AS TEMPLATE_ID , PT_PROJECT_ID AS PT_PROJECT_ID , CAST(HEADER_COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS HEADER_COMPONENTS_JSON , CAST(FOOTER_COMPONENTS_JSON AS CHAR) AS FOOTER_COMPONENTS_JSON , CAST(COLOR_JSON AS CHAR) AS COLOR_JSON , GEN_STATUS_CD AS GEN_STATUS_CD , ERROR_MSG AS ERROR_MSG , FRAME_IMAGE_PATH AS FRAME_IMAGE_PATH , CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT , MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_PT_TEMPLATE WHERE PT_PROJECT_ID = #{ptProjectId}
mapper.insert: /* PT 템플릿 신규 등록 proposal.insertPtTemplate */ INSERT INTO TB_PT_TEMPLATE ( TEMPLATE_ID, PT_PROJECT_ID, HEADER_COMPONENTS_JSON, FOOTER_COMPONENTS_JSON, COLOR_JSON, GEN_STATUS_CD, ERROR_MSG, CREATE_DT, CREATE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{templateId}, #{ptProjectId}, #{headerComponentsJson}, #{footerComponentsJson}, #{colorJson}, #{genStatusCd}, #{errorMsg}, NOW(), #{createUserId} )
